question: A closed loop is placed in a magnetic field and the magnetic flux linked with the loop at an instant is $1 \text{ Weber}$. Determine what can be concluded about the induced EMF from this information alone.

options.A: The induced EMF in the loop is $1 \text{ Volt}$.
options.B: The induced current in the loop is non-zero.
options.D: We cannot determine the induced EMF without knowing how the flux changes with time.
